mostWorthwhile.text: Recovering glucose from the filtered sample was most worthwhile: it showed why filtering is followed by selective recovery, rather than simply removing everything that enters the tubule.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder felt repetitive after the urine had already been shown travelling to the bladder. The bladder fitting added no explanation.

surprise.text: I was struck that healthy kidneys normally recover almost all filtered glucose. That made their selective role clearer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but fitting the urinary organs after already seeing urine reach the bladder felt somewhat redundant.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it continued connecting systems, but the predictable fittings and repeated route reduced my enthusiasm.
